The '''Lucrusia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of [[Lucrusian fengrill]]s.<ref name="GG1">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations|story=Never Had A Chance}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Lucrusian fengrill]]s|system=Lucrusia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lucrusia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
